title: whl
tagline: Whl is a decentralized calendar dapp for mapping astrological and symbols to meaningful contributions for learning esoterics using a proof-of-lore approach.
description: Whl aims to unravel contributors relationship with time and IRL activities symbolizing a type wheel of fortune for lore creators to earn a fee for constructing calendars. Generally curious as to what are the uncensorable characteristics that come from just pure gratitude for someone, something, an idea, or to that of a symbol derived from media lore to encompass an epoch of certain passing times, like chords of notes with alchemical performant standards for which are upheld astrally.
how_its_made: The project uses react as the front end, and uses a few visual libraries to accent the abstract ways to represent how the system will provide value to its users. Within the app, livepeer's video minting NFT is used to create snapshots on a day to day basis, and superfluid to stream payments to the Oracles that create community lore.
